ingestionIntegrations.limits: Independent copied-database, loopback integration checks; synthetic JPEG input under1MB, not a representative real-poster savings average. These are separate from CI counts and may overlap.

limitations.network: OFFLINE ONLY: all non-loopback browser+server requests denied; not equivalent to initial baseline external-failure conditions
limitations.cache: Fresh context per cold; same-context reload labeled warm. Playwright request routing DISABLES HTTP CACHE; unlike initial baseline warm-cache samples. Service workers blocked.
limitations.limits: Top-frame Resource Timing excludes navigation and iframe resources and omits cross-origin byte detail without Timing-Allow-Origin; these byte totals are not total page transfer. Scroll frame timeout is recorded, not treated as smooth performance.
